title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your account, preferences, and demo data.

notifications.title: In-app notifications
notifications.description: Show partner role alerts and reminders in the notification bell.

resetData.title: Reset demo data
resetData.description: Clear goals, plans, applications, and profile. Your account is kept.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently remove your account and all associated demo data.

resetDialog.title: Reset demo data?
resetDialog.description: This clears your profile, goals, plans, and applications, then restarts onboarding. Your login is kept. This can't be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your account?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently removes your account and all demo data. You'll be returned to the sign-in page. This can't be undone.
